//: dist/scripts/*.js are the CLI entry-point shims: each re-exports a command and calls `new XCommand(argv).execute()`. They hold no logic of their own, and `npm test` drives every one of them end-to-end through the real binary. Counting them here only inflated the function denominator — the thresholds below are the ones that were calibrated against real code.
//merge-async: Each CLI process a test spawns leaves its own coverage file (8,000+ by 1.5.0, 5 GB): merged one at a time, the report needs ~400 MB instead of more than the 6 GB CI gives it.
